outcome: When a PLAN review is blocked by missing_scope_check, the terminal says scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence, scope_check_save already exists, a scope-plan reviewer must write it, and Authority completion still requires verified receipt proof.
facts: B-c251 produced an audited execution plan for this implementation.
Current story_review emits missing_scope_check from packages/main/src/handlers/story-review.ts when understanding exists and scope-check.json is absent.
scope_check_save already exists and writes signed scope-check.json through packages/main/src/handlers/scope-check.ts.
CLI help schema for scope_check_save is registered in packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts.
packages/main/src/tasks/story-review-ergonomics-smoke.ts already covers story_review ergonomics and can host a targeted regression assertion.
authority_status reports authorityMode=off, authorityReady=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, so Authority completion must fail closed without receipt-backed proof.
constraints: Do not weaken PLAN review gates.
Do not auto-generate scope-check.json or allow main-agent self-signing.
Do not confuse scope_contract_check with scope_check_save.
Do not claim receiptVerified, authorityDone, productionDone, or fullAuthorityDone without verified Authority Server receipt evidence.
Keep the change narrow and only fix the real guidance/actionability issue.
